plan.scope: Bind selected perceived meal before inference; actor and executor share that snapshot. Retain target preference and unmasked goals.
plan.features: 152 (v2 145 prefix + seven actual selected-meal measurements); original MLP/GRU sizes unchanged; v1/v2 remain loadable.
plan.training: Same teacher and correction corpora as v2, same seed2026 and30epochs, validation macroF1 selection, correction repeat4; held-out copying test deferred.
plan.diagnostic: Known seed263 from prior evaluation, used only as target-binding regression, not fresh evidence.
plan.rules: Same current healing10%, mating cutoff30%, mating damage interruption. No teacher fallback, no feasibility mask, no deployment.
plan.limitations: One training initialization and six seeds; input shape changes the parameter initialization stream even with the same seed.

known_failure_probe.interpretation: Frozen model on previous corrected model recorded trajectory; diagnostic, not an executed counterfactual or new-seed outcome.

selected_target_swap_probe.interpretation: Only seven selected-meal fields swapped; identical other inputs and pre-step GRU state. Input probe, not an engine rollout.

manifest.selection: argmax learned lifecycle logits, no teacher goal fallback; identical motor/engine rules
manifest.newborns: same learned weights, separate fresh GRU state

limitations: Six seeds and one training initialization; descriptive, not a statistical architecture ranking.
Same training corpus/recipe/seed, but changed input shape changes parameter initialization stream.
Snapshot consistency is an interface guarantee, not a feasibility mask or guarantee that goals are correct.
Both learned modes log selected-meal snapshots; only the v3 actor encodes that snapshot.
